title.narrative: Transforming the Financial Sector: Promoting Green Finance and Climate Risk Management in Colombia

description.narrative: The project seeks the adoption of sustainable strategies in the Colombian financial sector that promote green and climate financing in the real sector. To this end, the government of Colombia, Development Financial Institutions, and the banking sector in general will be supported in adopting sustainable strategies, standards, and climate-related risk management practices and strategies, including physical and transition risks, to increase green finance and sustainable finance flows, contributing to climate change mitigation impacts and Colombia’s NDCs targets.

The project seeks to accelerate green and climate-aligned financial flows in Colombia by leveraging the financial sector’s capital allocation and risk-mitigation capacity. In doing so, it aims to enhance resilience to climate- and nature-related risks while advancing inclusive, low-carbon development.By tackling regulatory, institutional, and market barriers in an integrated manner, the project will not only unlock green finance but also embed climate and nature considerations into the core of Colombia’s financial architecture. The overarching goal is to foster a robust financial ecosystem that channels capital efficiently toward sustainable, equitable, and climate-resilient growth pathways, while preserving macroeconomic stability and reducing systemic exposure to environmental risks.
